How they count (D3b-1): cell-level (D3b-1): a capped (kind, presentation) cell contributes min(0, its summed paired difference) to the effect size and the per-kind non-inferiority, recomputed inside every bootstrap resample; the significance test uses the uncapped differences only (P2)

kind_noninferiority.statistic: the capped statistic of that kind alone, per world set

analysis.null_scope: exchangeability of the two arms within a world set (sign-symmetric difference), tested on the UNCAPPED differences (D3b-1, P2); a composite null 'mean <= 0' with an asymmetric difference distribution is not covered. Accepted by the owner and stated as the claim's scope (D2, 2026-10-20). Disclosed by the final scientific review (2026-10-20): (I-1) which cells are capped depends partly on registered arms' outcomes, the comparator's included, so the size is conditional on that partition and can exceed nominal slightly; the candidate cannot steer it; an owner option not taken is to derive the cap set from arms other than the comparator or from separate seeds. (I-6) a candidate that gains uncapped but loses in capped cells is stopped only by the percentile-bootstrap lower bound, whose level is approximate. (I-5) the bootstrap uses numpy's Generator.multinomial; the numpy version is bound by the formal environment manifest (D7)
analysis.power_study: authorised by the owner (ODC-O1b, D2, 2026-10-20): a bounded, non-formal power and null-calibration study on SYNTHETIC records only, run after D3 fixes the caps; its result is evidence for the owner, never a formal measurement. sign_flip.statistic: sum over world sets of the paired difference over UNCAPPED kinds only (one-sided, H1 candidate better); capped cells never enter the significance test (D3b-1, P2). Residual (disclosed): whoever runs the registry could generate unpublished admissions and keep one; the evaluator's inbox binds the first published admission, and the worlds mix in the same nonce
